1170-1329-1492-8296.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
1170-1329-1492-8296.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Welding Jar from your graveyard.
Cast Welding Jar by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Welding Jar by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

7084-7272-7422.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
You control another nonland creature.
7084-7272-7422.description:
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Reaper of Flight Moonsilver ability.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Garrison Excavator triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Reaper of Flight Moonsilver ability.
Repeat.

4460-4770-5301-6006.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Rin and Seri triggers, creating a 1/1 Dog creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Dog token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-789-3249-3755--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-789-3249-3755--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Elven Chorus by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Gutter Grime triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

3773-6972-8095--112.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Cultivator of Blades.
When Cultivator of Blades dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Cultivator of Blades enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.
3773-6972-8095--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Cultivator of Blades's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

586-864-2267-2511-3125.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-2267-2511-3125.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Tormod.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Tormod trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Tormod triggers, creating a creature token
Repeat.

5641-7687-7811.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
5641-7687-7811.description:
Draw a card.
Iron Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mister Fantastic triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

2411-3259-6791.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2411-3259-6791.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Lathril, triggering Breath of Fury and Lathril.
Resolve the Lathril trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3132-3259-4460.easyPrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
3132-3259-4460.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3132-3259-4460.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Bladewing, triggering Breath of Fury and Bladewing.
Resolve the Bladewing trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

129-1409-3480-6723.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

2034-3129-5220-6961-7422.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
2034-3129-5220-6961-7422.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Garrison Excavator triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

413-6972-7379.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Zack Fair.
When Zack Fair dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
When Zack Fair enters, Blasting Station trigger, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

206-1550-4251.notablePrerequisites:
Sword of Hearth and Home attached to any Samurai you control.
Godo and the Samurai with Sword of Hearth and Home attached cannot be blocked by an opponent.
206-1550-4251.description:
Declare Godo and the Samurai with Sword of Hearth and Home attached as attackers.
Godo's second ability triggers, untapping it and all Samurai you control, and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage using Godo and the Samurai that has Sword of Hearth and Home attached.
Sword of Hearth and Home triggers, causing you to exile Godo, then search your library for a basic land card and exile it, then put the land and Godo from exile onto the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

2301-6797-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
2301-6797-7084.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Abzan Ascendancy and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Abzan Ascendancy trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more charge counters on it

3918-7274--127.description:
Activate Trazyn using Golem Foundry's ability by removing three charge counters from it, creating a 3/3 Golem artifact creature token.
Activate Trazyn using the Spacecraft's station ability by tapping the Golem, putting three charge counters on Trazyn.
Repeat.

2510-4002-4331-4993.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more lands that share a name.
2510-4002-4331-4993.notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
2510-4002-4331-4993.description:
Activate Sceptre of Eternal Glory by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Sceptre of Eternal Glory.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {0}.
Repeat.

955-2440-3581-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
Kykar triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Spirit you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Spirit token.
Activate the Spirit token by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature a returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
955-2440-3581-7109.notes: The cost can be reduced to as little as {1} if you control other Spirits. You can also sacrifice the Spirits once you have enough to get infinite {R}.

414-4613-7096.easyPrerequisites:
You control a creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
You've had a land enter this turn.
414-4613-7096.description:
Activate a creature using Grist's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing you to create a 1/1 Insect creature token and mill a card, and then put a loyalty counter on the creature and repeat the process if the card was an Insect.
The Insect enters the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Bioengineered Future, causing it to have Grist's abilities.
Repeat from step 1 using the Insect token instead.

2292-5220-5931-6900.notablePrerequisites:
Funeral Room is unlocked.
Gwenom has attacked this turn.
2292-5220-5931-6900.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing it.
When Viscera Seer dies, Mortuary and Funeral Room trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Viscera Seer from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Funeral Room trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Cast Viscera Seer from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

2060-2510-4770-6930.notablePrerequisites: There is a creature card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
2060-2510-4770-6930.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {W}.
Spider-Man India triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

560-2457-3480-4289.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

2558-4848-5687-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Domri, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Repeat.

647-3259-5768.notablePrerequisites:
Origin of the Hidden Ones has exactly two lore counters on it.
You control at least one Assassin that does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
647-3259-5768.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Origin of the Hidden Ones triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
Origin of the Hidden Ones' third chapter ability triggers, causing you to create an Assassin token whenever an Assassin attacks this turn and sacrifice Origin of the Hidden Ones.
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached, and at least one Assassin if the creature with Breath of Fury attached isn't an Assassin, as attackers.
Origin of the Hidden Ones triggers, creating a 1/1 Assassin creature token that's tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Assassin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

4499-4605-5424-5542.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Sailor of Means.
When Sailor of Means enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, and Preston trigger twice if it has power 2 or less, or once otherwise.
Resolve both Sailor of Means triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the first Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Sailor of Means that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Sailor of Means token enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Repeat from step 4 for the remaining Preston trigger, if applicable.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Repeat.

486-1061-2043.notablePrerequisites:
You have the city's blessing.
Timestream Navigator does not have summoning sickness.
486-1061-2043.description:
Activate Liquimetal Torque's second ability by tapping it, causing Timestream Navigator to become an artifact until end of turn.
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Timestream Navigator that is a 1/1 Soldier creature.
Activate the oldest Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it on the bottom of your library from the battlefield, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1396-3384-5314.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature that can attack this turn and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
An opponent has at least six cards in hand, or you have at least seven cards in hand.
1396-3384-5314.description:
Cast Whispering Madness by paying {2}{U}{B}, causing each player to discard your hand, then draw cards equal to the greatest number of cards discarded this way, with you drawing double that number due to Thought Reflection.
Whispering Madness' cipher ability triggers, exiling Whispering Madness encoded on a creature you control.
Mystic Redaction triggers for each card you discarded, causing each opponent to mill two cards for each card you discarded.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Whispering Madness encoded.
The creature triggers, casting a copy of Whispering Madness without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of Whispering Madness, causing each player to discard your hand, then draw cards equal to the greatest number of cards discarded this way, with you drawing double that number due to Thought Reflection.
Mystic Redaction triggers for each card you discarded, causing each opponent to mill two cards for each card you discarded.
Move to your cleanup step, and discard cards down to your maximum hand size.
Mystic Redaction triggers for each card you discarded, causing each opponent to mill two cards for each card you discarded.

579-2816-3586.notablePrerequisites:
Umbral Mantle attached to Magus Lucea Kane.
Magus Lucea Kane does not have summoning sickness.
579-2816-3586.description:
Activate Magus Lucea Kane by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Magus Lucea Kane by paying {3} and untapping it, giving itself +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.
You may then cast a spell or activate an ability with {X} in its mana cost, getting infinite copies of that spell or ability.

uses.n: Jorn, God of Winter // Kaldring, the Rimestaff

1067-2010-3094.notablePrerequisites:
Jorn does not have summoning sickness.
Snow permanents you control can tap to produce at least {3}.
1067-2010-3094.description:
Activate Rimefeather Owl by paying {1}{S}, putting an ice counter on Lithoform Engine, causing Lithoform Engine to become a snow permanent.
Move to your combat phase, and declare Jorn as an attacker, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate all mana producing snow permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}.
Activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Jorn's triggered ability.
Resolve the copy of Jorn's ability, untapping all snow permanents you control.
Repeat from step 3.

225-539-1257-3478.description:
Activate Walking Atlas by tapping it, putting Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Walking Atlas as it is a land due to Ashaya.
Repeat.

1116-3240-3623-4289.description:
Activate Corpse Blockade by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Sek'Kuar triggers, creating a 3/1 Graveborn creature token creature with haste.
Resolve the Corpse Blockade ability, giving it deathtouch until end of turn.
Activate the Graveborn token using the ability from Cryptolith Rite by tapping it, adding {B}.
Activate Corpse Blockade by sacrificing the Graveborn token.
Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Corpse Blockade ability, giving it deathtouch until end of turn.
Activate Nether Traitor using the ability from Cryptolith Rite by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

521-1494-1692-3048.notablePrerequisites:
Helm of the Host and Mirror Mockery attached to Roalesk.
One opponent can be attacked.
521-1494-1692-3048.description:
At the beginning of combat, Helm of the Host will trigger, making a nonlegendary copy of Roalesk.
When the Roalesk token ETBs, put the 2 +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Attack with the nontoken Roalesk.
Mirror Mockery triggers, making a copy of Roalesk.
Place its ETB trigger onto the stack targeting Sage of hours, then sacrifice this token copy due to the legend rule, proliferating the +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours up to 4.
Resolve the ETB trigger, increasing the total number of +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours to 6.
Remove all +1/+1 counters from Sage of Hours to take an extra turn.
Repeat for infinite turns.

914-2034-5003.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least two artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-2034-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, adding {C}{C}.
Dockside Extortionist dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding two mana of any color.
Repeat.
